label: The Berlin Wall, half Trump and half Reagan, and bring down that curtain
description: The Berlin Wall seen in Germany with half of Trump's face and half of Reagan's, and the call to bring down the wall of the iron curtain. Given 11 December 2025.

label: A briefcase device stuck to the side of a cruise ship
description: A boat coming alongside a cruise ship and slapping a briefcase-sized device onto the hull with a sticky substance, with a radioactive marking on it and the word dirty heard in prayer. Given 10 December 2025.

label: Venezuelan retaliation on American soil disguised as cartel activity
description: An attack inside America that will look like drug cartel activity but is an act of war from Venezuela in retaliation, because they cannot face the American military directly. Given 10 December 2025.

label: The New York subway, early in the morning
description: The New York City subway system seen again, with the timing given as early in the morning. Given 9 December 2025, alongside the earlier word about flooding the tunnels.
